tool_args.rationale: The 8 observations show strong sink-associated reversal, but u_now and s_grad co-vary, leaving the branch mechanism poorly identified. The lowest-cost remaining informative probe is an extra trajectory batch; it can supply additional variation to distinguish stationary response families after three confirmation failures.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit another stationary sink-inhibition model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Three distinct fits have failed fresh confirmation, and the high-gradient data show a sharp sign reversal not captured by those candidates.
Fresh confirmation has refuted several models, but not all plausible stationary smooth mechanisms; the supplied observations do not show high-frequency sign oscillations.
It is not informative for distinguishing the response mechanisms and is explicitly disallowed.
